name: tuskledger-marketplace
description: One-click install + AI-assistant wiring for Tusk Ledger, the local-first personal finance app at tuskledger.com.

plugins.name: tuskledger
plugins.description: Bundles the tuskledger-mcp server (typed read access to your local Tusk Ledger data via 13 tools) plus slash commands for guided install (/tuskledger-install) and environment health checks (/tuskledger-doctor). Adding this plugin means your AI assistant can answer 'how much did I spend on coffee last month' and 'is my .env wired up correctly' against your real local data — no cloud, no proxy, no copying secrets into a chat.
